found.quote: Staff and students will not be permitted to present work completed by AI applications as their own without acknowledgement.
results and outputs produced by generative AI tools may be inaccurate, irrelevant is misleading. Users must always ensure the accuracy of results produced by generative AI tools.
There will be active monitoring and mitigation of bias in AI systems and their usage within the University and its programmes to ensure fairness and prevent discrimination.
The University will provide necessary accommodations and support to ensure equitable access to AI-based resources and services.
Use of any AI applications must comply with relevant General Data Protection Regulations (GDPR).
Staff and students should not enter any identifiable information into any AI application.

Staff or students are not permitted to upload student assessment, or any identifiable data without explicit written consent, to AI applications for any reason (including attempts to check for AI generated content).

Assessment will be designed to ensure that integrity and standards are maintained where students have access to generative AI, without sacrificing the importance of authenticity of assessment and pedagogic practice.
